findings.evidence: Temurin 25.0.3+9 launches confirmed default SATB, explicit generational without experimental unlock and ignored compact with adaptive startup logs. PrintFlagsFinal still displays compact, so the existing requirement to read warnings/effective startup policy is consequential.
findings.consequence: Avoids accepting a successful launch or raw option value as proof of the intended comparison mode.

findings.evidence: Oracle JDK 25 guide supports SoftMaxHeapSize as a heuristic and the minimum-heap uncommit floor. Owned Xms=Xmx launch reports Uncommit: Implicitly Disabled and ZUncommit=false despite requesting it.
findings.consequence: Avoids treating soft max as a container cap or reducing a delay to override a fixed-heap floor.

findings.result: Historical status remains accurate on the current source check
findings.evidence: Official JEP 535 page: Targeted, release 28; JEP 523: Closed/Delivered, release 27; JEP 521: Closed/Delivered, release 25 and single-generation default retained.
findings.consequence: Existing text correctly separates product, default, target release and deployed binary; a date-only edit would add no supported decision improvement.

findings.evidence: OpenJDK jdk-25-ga ZPageAllocator::alloc_page_stall creates EventZAllocationStall, requests asynchronous minor collection, waits for allocation completion/failure and commits the event. The skill separately preserves unknown/empty populations, concurrent wall-time versus CPU and generation/mode comparability.
findings.consequence: Avoids converting cycle labels to stall counts or using unsupported empty/short samples as latency or cost evidence.
